# Bhikkhunī Vibhaṅga Pācittiya 74 (Bi-Vb Pc74)

**ID:** Bi-Vb Pc74
**Section:** Bhikkhunī Vibhaṅga (bi-vb)
**Collection:** Vinaya
**Title (Pali):** Bhikkhunī Vibhaṅga Pācittiya 74
**Title (English, from literature):** Giving ordination while under twelve years’ seniority
**tipitaka.org (CST):** https://tipitaka.org/romn/cscd/vin02m1.mul7.xml

## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

Within the Vinaya's cluster of regulations on ordination requirements, the background scenario of Pācittiya 74 is schematically repeated in Pācittiya 75, which introduces the subsequent requirement of formal Saṅgha authorization (*sammuti*) for mentors who have reached twelve years of seniority [Hüsken 1997]. Full Vinaya parallels exist across all major traditions, including the Theravāda Bhikkhunī Pātimokkha and Parivāra, as well as Dharmaguptaka, Mahīśāsaka, Sarvāstivāda, Mūlasarvāstivāda (extant in Chinese and Tibetan), Mahāsāṅghika, and Lokottaravāda versions. The text has been translated into English by Bhikkhu Brahmali.
